entities.summary: Madonna Buder,, also known as the Iron Nun, is an American Senior Olympian triathlete and religious sister. Buder has the current world record for the oldest woman to ever finish an Ironman Triathlon, which she obtained at age 82 by finishing the Subaru Ironman Canada on August 26, 2012.
